title: Preliminary contour map on the top of the Eocene Series, Charleston area, South Carolina
citation: Higgins, B.B., Gohn, G.S., and Bybell, L.M., 1978, Preliminary contour map on the top of the Eocene Series, Charleston area, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-78-548, map scale 1:250,000.
notes:
Map plate (p.1, OCR) plus short report (pp.2-6). Contour map of the top of the Eocene defined by 167 data points (p.4), mostly from gamma logs of water wells; contours dashed where control is sparse; stippled areas where the Oligocene Cooper is absent. Only one contour label (-40) legible; '50-' and 'B0' are garbled and not recorded. Legend symbols (auger holes, exposures, water wells) not recorded. Authors report no clearly defined tectonic elements such as faults have been proved (p.4).
SUBSURFACE: Fig. 2 (p.5) is a gamma log with picks for the tops of the Oligocene, Eocene, Santee Ls., Macrofossil Ls. and Black Mingo Fm. against a depth scale (20-130), but the well is not identified and the depth of each pick cannot be read from the OCR; contour datum not stated; the 167 control points are not listed.
